title: The Question a Health Poster Cannot Answer
title_ja: 健康ポスターでは答えられない問い
fact_notes: オリジナル論説・架空事例。実在の政策、医療助言、教育効果、調査結果ではない。台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A poster can provide information about health-related activities to people who might not otherwise encounter that information during their ordinary lives.
sentences.ja: ポスターは日常生活でそうでなければ出会わないかもしれない健康関連活動の情報を人に提供できる。

sentences.en: Its effectiveness as a form of communication may depend on the clarity of its language and the extent to which its intended audience is able to understand the message.
sentences.ja: 意思疎通手段としての有効性は言語の明確さと想定読者がどの程度内容を理解できるかに依存し得る。

sentences.en: However, understanding a recommendation does not necessarily establish that a person has a practical opportunity to act on it.
sentences.ja: しかし推奨を理解しても本人にそれを実行する実際の機会があるとは限らない。

sentences.en: This difference is particularly important when an organization wishes to improve participation in an activity intended to support well-being.
sentences.ja: 組織が健康や生活の充実を支える活動への参加改善を望むとき特に重要な違いである。

sentences.en: Imagine a fictional community center that organizes a regular group activity intended to encourage social interaction and gentle movement.
sentences.ja: 社会交流と穏やかな身体活動を促す定期集団活動を企画する架空地域センターを想像しよう。

sentences.en: The organizers prepare posters explaining where and when the activity takes place, and they place the posters in several public locations.
sentences.ja: 主催者は場所と時刻を説明するポスターを作り複数の公共地点に置く。

sentences.en: When participation remains lower than they had expected, some organizers suggest that the community needs more information about the benefits of the activity.
sentences.ja: 参加が期待ほど多くないため、一部は活動の利点について地域にさらに情報が必要と提案する。

sentences.en: Others ask whether people who already understand the invitation have encountered difficulties that prevent them from attending.
sentences.ja: 別の者は既に招待を理解している人が出席を妨げる困難に直面したか尋ねる。

sentences.en: The organizers discuss several possible barriers, including the timing of the sessions, the availability of transportation, and uncertainty about what participants would be expected to do.
sentences.ja: 主催者は会合時間、交通手段の利用可能性、参加者が何を求められるかの不確かさを含む複数の可能な障害を議論する。

sentences.en: A person who finds the activity appealing might nevertheless be unable to attend at the scheduled time.
sentences.ja: 活動を魅力的だと感じる人も予定時刻に出席できない場合がある。

sentences.en: Another person might wish to obtain additional information about the activity before deciding whether it would be suitable for their circumstances.
sentences.ja: 別の人は活動が自身の事情に適するか決める前に追加情報を得たいかもしれない。

sentences.en: The organizers recognize that distributing more copies of the same poster would not necessarily address these different difficulties.
sentences.ja: 同じポスターの複製をより多く配布しても異なる困難に必ずしも対処しないと認識する。

sentences.en: The fictional center considers asking people about their experiences of attempting to participate, rather than assuming that low attendance demonstrates a lack of interest.
sentences.ja: 架空センターは低出席が関心不足を示すと想定せず参加を試みた経験を人々に尋ねることを考える。

sentences.en: Answers to such questions might help the organizers identify aspects of their arrangements that deserve further examination.
sentences.ja: 問いへの回答は追加検討に値する仕組みの側面を特定する助けになり得る。

sentences.en: The example does not establish the health effects of any particular activity or the effectiveness of a real participation program.
sentences.ja: 例は特定活動の健康効果や実際の参加制度の有効性を確立しない。

sentences.en: It concerns the distinction between making information available and making an opportunity practically accessible.
sentences.ja: 情報の利用可能化と機会の実際のアクセス可能化の区別に関わる。

sentences.en: Communication is often an important part of an activity intended to support health and well-being.
sentences.ja: 意思疎通は健康と生活の充実を支える活動の重要部分であることが多い。

sentences.en: Yet information can answer only some of the questions that influence a person's ability to participate.
sentences.ja: しかし情報は人の参加能力に影響する問いの一部にしか答えられない。

sentences.en: Understanding that limitation encourages organizations to investigate the circumstances in which their messages will be received and used.
sentences.ja: 限界を理解すると組織は内容が受け取られ使われる事情を調べるよう促される。

sentences.en: The question missing from a poster may be the question that reveals why its invitation has not become an opportunity.
sentences.ja: ポスターに欠けた問いは、招待がなぜ機会になっていないかを明らかにする問いかもしれない。

vocabulary.definition: quality of being easy to understand
in a way that must occur
state of being healthy and comfortable
give someone a reason to act

questions.prompt: Why might understanding a recommendation be insufficient?
options: A person may lack a practical opportunity to follow it.
Health information cannot be expressed in writing.

questions.prompt: What activity does the fictional center organize?
options: An activity encouraging social interaction and gentle movement.
questions.explanation_ja: 交流・穏やかな身体活動。

questions.prompt: What distinction arises from low participation?
options: A lack of information may differ from barriers to attendance.
The posters prove nobody is interested.
Only the printed language can affect participation.
The activity has already been canceled.
Timing, transportation and uncertainty about the activity.
Only the weather during the entire year.
questions.explanation_ja: 時間・交通・不確かさ。

questions.prompt: Why might a person who likes the idea still not attend?
options: The session may conflict with their circumstances.
They cannot have understood the invitation.
They must prefer a different poster design.

questions.prompt: What does the center consider asking people about?
options: The number of activities in other countries.
Their experiences of trying to participate.

questions.prompt: What does the example not establish?
options: A distinction between information and access.
Specific health effects or actual program effectiveness.
questions.explanation_ja: 健康効果の実証ではない。

options: The conditions under which people receive and use their messages.
Only the number of printed notices.
The price of every activity regardless of needs.
Only the intended audience's vocabulary size.
questions.explanation_ja: 情報の受領・利用条件。

options: Health communication should consider practical access as well as the information it provides.
Low attendance proves that people lack interest.
Every health-related activity has identical benefits.

grammar.focus: before deciding whether it would be suitable
in which their messages will be received and used
grammar.explanation_ja: 前置詞＋関係代名詞、受動態。

paraphrases.source: However, understanding a recommendation does not necessarily establish that a person has a practical opportunity to act on it.
paraphrases.rewrite: Knowing a recommendation does not prove someone can follow it.

paraphrases.source: Others ask whether people who already understand the invitation have encountered difficulties that prevent them from attending.
paraphrases.rewrite: Some people may understand the notice but face barriers to attendance.

paraphrases.source: Another person might wish to obtain additional information about the activity before deciding whether it would be suitable for their circumstances.
paraphrases.rewrite: A person may seek further details to judge whether an activity fits their circumstances.

paraphrases.source: Understanding that limitation encourages organizations to investigate the circumstances in which their messages will be received and used.
paraphrases.rewrite: Organizations should consider the situations where people will use the information.
